title: Iron Kingdoms
description: Official modpack for Iron Kingdoms server
body:
- Iron Kingdoms: Steam & Sorcery


  Welcome to Iron Kingdoms, a "Full Metal Fantasy" modpack where the clatter of gears meets the hum of ancient magic. Built for a high-stakes community experience, this pack combines industrial engineering with arcane mastery in a world driven by player-led conflict and racial identity.

⚙️ Key Features:
- Choose Your Ancestry: Define your playstyle from the start. Become a sturdy Dwarf, an agile Elf, a fierce Orc, a mystical Fairy, or a versatile Merfolk. Each race brings its own unique flavor to the industrial revolution.
- Industrial Arcana: Harness the power of the Create mod to build massive factories and automated defenses, while mastering the mystical arts of Ars Nouveau. In this world, technology and magic are two sides of the same coin.
- Kingdoms & Factions: Claim your land and build your empire. With a robust faction system, players can manage territories, forge strategic alliances, or ignite world-spanning wars between the different races.
- Guilds & Mercenaries: Not everyone wants to wear a crown. Join specialized Guilds to complete contracts, trade rare resources, or sell your combat skills to the highest-bidding kingdom.
- Total Diplomacy or Total War: Build monumental cities—from subterranean dwarven fortresses to elven groves—and defend them from sieges. The map is shaped entirely by player actions.
- Optimized PvP Performance: A smooth, competitive environment where every spell cast, every machine built, and every racial ability counts when defending your borders.

 🛠️ Evolution of Power
 
In Iron Kingdoms, you don't just survive—you industrialize. Will you lead your kin to a golden age of steam, or will your kingdom fall to the gears of progress?

Join the revolution. Forge your destiny in the Iron Kingdoms.
